state status value

  • CURIE: gmeow:stateStatusValue
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateStatusValue
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/languages

The vitality status(es) asserted for the language during this state. NON-FUNCTIONAL: different authorities may assign different statuses for the same interval, and those claims coexist (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:LanguageState -> gmeow:LanguageStatus

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:stateStatusValue from gmeow:LanguageState to gmeow:LanguageStatus when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:LanguageState, gmeow:LanguageStatus
